jud.text: The Order is caught up in the hunt for the Mirari in Judgment, when Laquatus, trapped by Llawan's mages and failing diplomatically with the Order and the Cabal, goes to the mainland with Burke to retrieve it. An Order contingent led by Eesha and a Cabal battalion led by Braids head to the mountains while Laquatus plays them against each other.
An unknown assailant attacks the camps in the forest and the Order leader is killed, which is blamed on the Cabal, and the Cabal leaves.

Elsewhere, Kirtar organizes a coup, demands command of the Order and uses the Mirari to engulf Pianna in crystals. The spell spreads out of control, and Turg steals the Mirari while Kirtar fades to nothing as the spell drains his essence.
